text:
zane: Tiny lunchtime thing: 'Model Zodiac Fair' 1 Everyone picks an LLM and writes its horoscope for the week. Could be hilarious. :crystal_ball:
leila: This is peak watercooler. I'm in. 'GPT-4 Turbo' is definitely a Capricorn who plans sprints like marriages. :calendar:
omar: Rules? Keep it silly, no real PD, and maybe tag the decoding mode. temp=0 for 'serious oracle', temp=0.9 for 'mystic improv'.
mira: Ops-bot  can you reserve the big table + whiteboard next Friday? We'll tape horoscopes and let people vote for "Most Uncanny Prediction."
ops-bot: Table 4 reserved Friday 12:00-13:00 in Kitchen B. Whiteboard delivered. Event: Model Zodiac Fair. RSVP with :wave:. Reminder set 24h prior.
leila: Example horoscope card format:
```
Model: <name> (variant)
Mode: deterministic / freestyle
Horoscope: one-liner prediction in-character
Lucky input: <prompt type to try>
```
zane: Prompt idea for a demo card: "Write a horoscope for a CI pipeline that just passed."
omar: Also we should have micro-challenges: emoji-only horoscope, commit-message horoscope, and haiku horoscope. Winners get a mystery snack. :doughnut:
mira: design  can you whip up a tiny tarot-ish poster with LLM doodles? nothing fancy, just vibes.
design: Yeah! Tiny poster mockups incoming. Should we include a 'decoding badge' icon for each card? (temp0, temp0.7, top-p, etc.)
leila: Safety lane: any horoscope that veers into personal advice gets rerouted to the 'gentle refusal' card. We'll tape a sticker on it: "Refused: Please consult a human." :thinking_face:
zane: Sample horoscope for demo: ```
Model: Mistral (top-p 0.9)
Horoscope: "This week you will accidentally reply-all but discover a new snack drawer. Embrace crumbs."
Lucky input: "Write a breakroom PSA as a dramatic poem."
```
omar: I'm already imagining differences: greedy signatures will be pragmatic forecasts, top-p will be melodramatic. Good observational experiment.
mira: Ops-bot  can you add a tiny poll to this thread: "planning to bring a horoscope?" so we know how many index cards to print?
ops-bot: Poll added: "Will you bring a horoscope card?" Options: Yes / Maybe / No.
design: I'll make stickers for 'Most Likely to Predict the Snacks' and 'Most Dramatic Metaphor'. Also a small legend explaining decoding badges.
leila: Prompt challenge: "Horoscope written by a disgruntled pager who secretly loves puns." winner gets last pastry.
zane: OK I'll print 40 index cards and a marker set. Drop any wild prompt ideas here and I'll slip them into the freestyle deck. :wave:
